integrity_notes: Proof applies to arbitrary fields. Exact finite-field verification covers 68 witness parameter pairs and 13,382 exhaustively checked small cases; computational checks are not a general proof or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only the Gallo–Videla path Lie algebra and one explicit regular functional; no full rank-distribution or all-tree classification. Possible unindexed prior band-matrix formula has not been eliminated.
title: Kirillov index and mod-three stabilizers of three-step path Lie algebras
